title: Localqw6 OMER GUI V7
script:
local player = game.Players.LocalPlayer
local screenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
screenGui.Parent = player:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui") or player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
screenGui.Name = "OMER_GUI_V7"

local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
frame.Size = UDim2.new(0.3, 0, 0.6, 0)
frame.Position = UDim2.new(0.35, 0, 0.2, 0)
frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 30)
frame.BorderSizePixel = 2
frame.Parent = screenGui

local function createButton(name, position, callback)
    local button = Instance.new("TextButton")
    button.Size = UDim2.new(0.8, 0, 0.1, 0)
    button.Position = UDim2.new(0.1, 0, position, 0)
    button.Text = name
    button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(50, 50, 50)
    button.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    button.Parent = frame
    button.MouseButton1Click:Connect(callback)
end

-- **Sürüklenebilir GUI**
local dragging, dragStart, startPos
frame.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
        dragging = true
        dragStart = input.Position
        startPos = frame.Position
        input.Changed:Connect(function()
            if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
                dragging = false
            end
        end)
    end
end)

frame.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if dragging and input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then
        local delta = input.Position - dragStart
        frame.Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X, startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y)
    end
end)

-- **1. KARETER IŞILTI**
createButton("KARETER IŞILTI", 0.05, function()
    local character = player.Character
    if character then
        for _, v in pairs(character:GetChildren()) do
            if v:IsA("Clothing") or v:IsA("Shirt") or v:IsA("Pants") then
                v:Destroy()
            end
        end
        local glow = Instance.new("PointLight", character.Head)
        glow.Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 255)
        glow.Brightness = 5
        glow.Range = 10
    end
end)

-- **2. HİÇ GİTMEYEN HİNT**
createButton("HİÇ GİTMEYEN HİNT", 0.15, function()
    while true do
        game.StarterGui:SetCore("SendNotification", {Title = "XXXOMER12345678", Text = "Sonsuza kadar!"})
        wait(5)
    end
end)

-- **3. HARİTA DÖNDÜR**
createButton("HARİTA DÖNDÜR", 0.25, function()
    local map = game.Workspace
    while true do
        map:SetPrimaryPartCFrame(map.PrimaryPart.CFrame * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(10), 0))
        wait(0.1)
    end
end)

-- **4. MUSIC**
createButton("MUSIC", 0.35, function()
    local sound = Instance.new("Sound", game.Workspace)
    sound.SoundId = "rbxassetid://15689453529"
    sound.Volume = 999999
    sound:Play()
end)

-- **5. PHONK**
createButton("PHONK", 0.45, function()
    local sound = Instance.new("Sound", game.Workspace)
    sound.SoundId = "rbxassetid://16662831442"
    sound.Volume = 9999999
    sound:Play()
end)

-- **6. MESAJ TEKRARLANAN**
createButton("MESAJ TEKRARLANAN", 0.55, function()
    while true do
        game.StarterGui:SetCore("ChatMakeSystemMessage", {Text = "XXXOMER12345678", Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0), Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, FontSize = Enum.FontSize.Size24})
        wait(3)
    end
end)

-- **7. MODEL GLİHC**
createButton("MODEL GLİHC", 0.65, function()
    for _, model in pairs(game.Workspace:GetChildren()) do
        if model:IsA("Model") then
            model:SetAttribute("Burning", true)
            for _, part in pairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
                if part:IsA("BasePart") then
                    part.Color = Color3.fromRGB(math.random(255), 0, 0)
                    local fire = Instance.new("Fire", part)
                    fire.Size = 10
                    fire.Heat = 5
                end
            end
        end
    end
end)

-- **8. BLOK İLE NUKER**
createButton("BLOK İLE NUKER", 0.75, function()
    while true do
        local block = Instance.new("Part", game.Workspace)
        block.Size = Vector3.new(5, 5, 5)
        block.Position = player.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position + Vector3.new(math.random(-10, 10), 2, math.random(-10, 10))
        block.Color = Color3.fromRGB(math.random(255), math.random(255), math.random(255))
        wait(0.1)
    end
end)

-- **9. GUEST 666!?+0**
createButton("GUEST 666!?+0", 0.85, function()
    local character = player.Character
    if character then
        local effect = Instance.new("Explosion", character.Head)
        effect.BlastRadius = 5
        effect.BlastPressure = 5000

        character.HumanoidRootPart.Anchored = true
        wait(1)
        character.HumanoidRootPart.Anchored = false
        character.HumanoidRootPart.Velocity = Vector3.new(0, 50, 0)
        
        game.Lighting.FogEnd = 100
        game.Lighting.Ambient = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)

        for _, v in pairs(game.Workspace:GetDescendants()) do
            if v:IsA("BasePart") then
                local fire = Instance.new("Fire", v)
                fire.Size = 10
            end
        end
    end
end)
